item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-10-26
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 从这批帖子看，过去一天论坛有多条测试网产品和基础设施提案更新，整体不算完全安静[S01,S03,S05,S09,S10]。讨论主线之一是 Kirea Finance 的 RWA 借贷争议：有人质疑链上无法强制执行现实世界义务，项目方随后连续回应并补充链下与链上两层思路[S05,S06,S07]。另一条主线是开发者工具和测试网应用：CKB IDL 作者回应反馈，Nine Cells、Cellula Wallet、FiberNuts 等都在征集测试或迭代[S03,S04,S01,S09,S10]。此外，Twine 帖子有简短正面反馈，Nervlith 发布了品牌更名与平台介绍[S11,S12]。 ## 重点话题 Kirea Finance 继续围绕 RWA 强制执行展开讨论：社区成员指出 CKB 能约束链上合约，但不能直接约束现实世界义务[S05]；项目方回应称 RWA 需要链下与链上两层配合，并提到 Centrifuge、Goldfinch、Maple 等协议也不是仅靠智能合约执行现实义务[S06,S07]。项目方还把部分回答放到 metaforo 链接中，邀请继续提问[S08]。 CKB IDL 提案作者回应开发者体验关切：作者表示目标是让 IDL 生成和消费自然融入现有开发流程，而不是增加另一套复杂流程[S03]；同时认同应补充现有工具而非重复造轮子，并感谢此前对 CellScript registry 集成探索的帮助[S04]。 Nine Cells...

item.title: Nine Cells: a merge tower defense game (testnet) (2 posts)
item.description: Hi everyone, I’m Karas, a CKBuilder in the current cohort. I’ve been building Nine Cells, a browser tower defense game where you defend a wall by placing cats in lanes and merging two same-level cats into a stronger one. I’d like to share how it uses cells and get feedback, both on the game and on the script design. Play it: https://nine-cells.karasdev.com/ (CKB testnet) You can play the battles without a wallet. A CKB testnet wallet (JoyID or UTXO Global) is only needed to mint and keep cats on chain. Testnet CKB from the faucet covers the capacity and fees. Why cells fit this game The core action in the game is “two cats in, one stronger cat out”. That is exactly what a CKB transaction...

item.title: [DIS] CKB IDL: Interface Description Language and Discoverability for CKB Scripts (2 posts)
item.description: Thanks for the thoughtful feedback, @3m1n3nc3 Developer experience is one of my biggest priorities here. The goal is to make IDL generation and consumption fit naturally into existing development workflows, rather than introduce another complicated process. That’s partly why I’m working on Molecule-to-IDL generation and TypeScript support. On discoverability and composability, I agree. The Registry is intended to be a discovery and verification layer, not a source of trust. Consumers should be able to independently verify cryptographically bound interfaces against deployed scripts, regardless of where they retrieved the IDL. item.title: [DIS] Kirea Finance: Native RWA Lending Infrastructure for CKB |【DIS】Kirea Finance：面向 CKB 的原生 RWA 借贷基础设施 (4 posts)
item.description: Interesting concept, and I appreciate the considerable development effort already invested in Kirea Finance. However, I still see a fundamental challenge with real-world asset (RWA) enforcement. CKB can enforce on-chain contracts, but it cannot enforce real-world obligations. What happens if an invoice is never paid? What if the borrower receives payment but never reports it? How can the system verify that an invoice is genuine, unpaid, and hasn’t already been pledged elsewhere? Ultimately, this requires trusted third parties, external verification, and legal enforcement. Who takes responsibility for verifying and enforcing the underlying asset, and who bears the loss if the debtor...

item.title: Cellula Wallet beta on testnet: testers wanted until Monday 26 October (1 posts)
item.description: image1920×1008 241 KB Hi everyone, Cellula is the name you can pay: cellula.id gives you one name, yourname.cell, that people can pay instead of a blockchain address. Now we are testing the Cellula Wallet, a wallet that lives in your passkey, and we are looking for more testers: on Android, where the app is, and on the web, where the same wallet runs in any browser that can save a passkey. The beta runs until Monday 26 October at midnight (23:59 UTC). What it is Your passkey is the wallet: you open it with your fingerprint, face or screen lock, and there is no seed phrase to write down. item.title: FiberNuts Community Market: A Testnet App for Cashu + Fiber (1 posts)
item.description: Thanks for the detailed testing and feedback. I’ve now added a strict CSP, fixed the “1 claim” wording, improved security reporting, and added exact network/RUSD asset validation for cash-outs. Event-friendly faucet access, easier LSP-based funding, NUT-13 recovery, and NUT-11 refunds remain next-stage work.
